content: Expected locale-aware features in localized docs sites (evidence across Material, Docusaurus, VitePress, Google Search docs): correct html lang attribute per locale (accessibility, hyphenation, search); hreflang link headers/tags connecting translated versions (Docusaurus sets them automatically; Google Search Central documents them for localized versions); a visible language switcher (Material extra.alternate; VitePress locales link; Docusaurus navbar locale dropdown); direction support dir rtl for RTL locales (Docusaurus localeConfigs.direction, VitePress dir, Material inferred direction); locale-aware calendar/date defaults (Docusaurus localeConfigs defaults calendar format; pandoc localizes dates in PDF). Locale-aware number formatting is generally delegated to host platforms rather than doc generators themselves.
